# task\-error\-mapping\-hygiene — Fix MCP and issue\-path error mapping gaps
status: todo  priority: 3  scope: scope-core
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

From the 2026\-08\-15 complete code audit: \(a\) MCP \`catchDiag\` \(src/mcp/server\.ts:32\-38\) does not map \`ZodError\` to \`schema\_invalid\`, unlike CLI \`diagnosticFor\` \(src/cli/index\.ts:1044\-1047\) — e\.g\. an invalid \`post\_message\` kind returns \`unexpected\_error\`\. \(b\) \`issueFile\` \(src/core/issue\.ts:99\-109\) throws raw \`Error\` for unsafe ids instead of \`MutationError\`/a coded diagnostic, so invalid ids surface as \`unexpected\_error\` at every surface\. Fix both: add ZodError mapping in \`catchDiag\`, and make the unsafe\-issue\-id path throw a coded error\.

## Acceptance
- An MCP call with an invalid enum/kind \(e\.g\. a bad \`post\_message\` kind or \`create\_task\` status\) returns \`schema\_invalid\`, not \`unexpected\_error\`\.
- \`createIssue\`/\`updateIssue\`/\`closeIssue\` with an unsafe id \(e\.g\. containing slashes or \`\.\.\`\) returns a coded diagnostic \(\`schema\_invalid\` or \`invalid\_transition\`\), not \`unexpected\_error\`, across CLI, MCP, and dashboard\.
- All checks green: \`bun test\`, \`bun run typecheck\`, \`bun run check\`, \`waystation validate\`\.
